summary: Applied two unknown-run contract repairs within the approved product scope.

items.title: Missing target state for unknown preparing run guards
items.rationale: Defined an isolated empty preparing target snapshot for explicit missing runs so existing shared guard comparisons can reject supplied expectations without changing flow-target-guard ownership.
items.evidence: spec.json data_flow[0], overview.decisions[1], requirements R1, and AC2 now define the missing-run representation and behavior.

items.title: Unknown run error contract conflicts with guard-free preservation
items.rationale: Limited ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH to unknown-run invocations carrying expectation guards and preserved existing guard-free command-specific errors.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints[5], requirements R3/R4, and AC2/AC5/AC6 now distinguish guarded and guard-free unknown-run contracts.
